# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Measure — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #fafbfc);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #0f141b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fafbfc;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #fafbfc | #0f141b | Page background. From --paper. Dark value proposed. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #161d26 | Raised panels on paper: the diagram card, record blocks, example sheets. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #f0f3f8 | #1e2732 | Inline code, table header rows and quiet wells. ink-muted stays at 5.6:1 or better on it. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #192330);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #e8ecf2);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #192330;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #192330 | #e8ecf2 | All body text and headings. 15:1 on paper in both themes. From --ink. |
| `--ink-muted` | #566171 | #a3adbb | Secondary text: intros, captions, footer, labels. 6:1 on paper. From --muted. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--accent-hover, #1936b5);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--accent-tint` | #edf1ff | #1c2547 | Quiet accent ground: light-button hover, the statement block header, the cover's rule field. |
| `--accent-soft` | #b9c6f7 | #2b3a75 | Only the consumer circle of the mark (acceptance). Decorative, never behind text. |
| `--accent-soft-on-accent` | #7088ea | #5c74d6 | The consumer circle when the mark sits on an accent tile (app icon, cover slab). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #d9dee6);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #2a3440);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #d9dee6;
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #d9dee6 | #2a3440 | Decorative hairlines only: section dividers, table rules, card borders. Never the only edge of a control. From --line. |
| `--line-strong` | #8a94a3 | #5f6b7a | Borders that must be seen (controls, the provision rule, unanswered findings). 3:1 on surface. Proposed. |
| `--accent` | #2447dc | #8ea6ff | The one brand hue: links, primary buttons, eyebrows, focus rings, the mark. Use sparingly; never for a finding. From --blue. |
| `--selection` | #dbe3ff | #26336b | ::selection background. |
| `--draft-ink` | #75520b | #f0c674 | Text of the draft status banner and the expired finding. 6.3:1 on draft-tint. From the existing expired claim chip. |
| `--draft-tint` | #fcf1d7 | #2a2214 | Ground of the status banner and expired finding. |
| `--conflict-ink` | #9a3412 | #f4a07a | Only for a finding that evidence conflicts with a claim. Rust, not red: it reports a conflict, not a verdict. 6.4:1 on conflict-tint. Proposed. |
| `--conflict-tint` | #fdeee6 | #2d1a12 | Ground of a conflict finding. Proposed. |
| `--neutral-ink` | #3b4a5c | #c3ccd8 | Text of established and within-period findings, and the decision block label. Deliberately not green. Proposed. |
| `--neutral-tint` | #eef1f5 | #1e2732 | Ground of neutral findings and the explanation marker. Proposed. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 78px/1.04 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; letter-spacing: -0.045em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.045em;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 78px / 1.04, letter-spacing -0.045em | 400 | `serif` | Home hero only. Scale down with clamp(3.4rem, 5.1vw, 4.9rem). |
| `display-l` | `.display-l`, `--text-display-l` | 48px / 1.08, letter-spacing -0.04em | 400 | `serif` | Page titles and home section headings. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 32px / 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em | 400 | `serif` | h2 in reading pages and declaration principles. |
| `heading-s` | `.heading-s`, `--text-heading-s` | 22px / 1.3 | 600 | `serif` | h3. The only place the serif goes semibold. |
| `provision` | `.provision`, `--text-provision` | 18px / 1.7 | 400 | `serif` | Declaration body text inside a normative provision. Max width measure-prose. |
| `body-l` | `.body-l`, `--text-body-l` | 18px / 1.7 | 400 | `sans` | Intros and hero paragraphs, in ink-muted. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 1.65 | 400 | `sans` | Explanatory prose, UI text. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Labels, footer, captions, buttons. |
| `eyebrow` | `.eyebrow`, `--text-eyebrow` | 12px / 1.5, letter-spacing 0.1em | 600 | `sans` | Uppercase section labels in accent. Never a full sentence. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 1.7 | 400 | `mono` | Code blocks and inline code. |
| `identifier` | `.identifier`, `--text-identifier` | 13px / 1.5 | 500 | `mono` | Versions, digests, section numbers, finding labels. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `"Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Gap between a label glyph and its text. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Inline padding of finding labels and inline code. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Vertical padding of compact rows. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default gap; record block body padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card and banner padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between grouped blocks; header nav gap. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Between page sections on mobile. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Between page sections on desktop; footer top padding. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-0: 0) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-0), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-0` | 0 | Everything by default: buttons, cards, code blocks, banners. The system is square. |
| `--radius-1` | 2px | Focus rings and inline code only. |
| `--radius-mark` | 14px | The app-icon tile of the mark (14 on a 64 grid). Not for UI. |
